description: §5.2 executable-sink rule (S456 review F2): a quoted onclick with `${…}` spliced in by `^{ emit(…) }` is refused — the check runs over the post-meta AST.
rationale: §5.2 executable-sink rule applies "in every position (… and markup spliced in by `^{ emit(…) }`)". Before the fix the meta-emitted handler compiled to `setAttribute("onclick", `go('${…}')`)` at exit 0, because VP-3 runs before ME. S458 (review F3): impl#1 now refuses ANY interpolated or logic attribute value in emit() output at the emit gate (§22.4.1 impl#1 status — "with plain attribute values"), so this body is refused there, before the §5.2 check over the spliced nodes would see it: E-META-EVAL-002. The SPEC §5.2 rule is unchanged; this case pins that the meta-emitted handler is still refused, by the stricter gate.
